title: Trajectory under State Embedding
statement: Let $M$ and $N$ be machines with the same number of work tapes and input alphabet, with state sets $S$ and $H$, and let $C$ be a contract for $M$ with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$. Let $\\mathrm{emb}:S\\hookrightarrow H$ be an injective map, and let $\\mathrm{good}$ be a property of states in $S$. Suppose that whenever $q$ is good, the transition of $N$ at $\\mathrm{emb}(q)$ is the transition of $M$ at $q$ with its successor state mapped by $\\mathrm{emb}$. Suppose also that, for every data value $i$ and admissible start configuration $c$ in state $e$, every state visited by $M$ at a time strictly less than $C$’s assigned time is good. Then for every $i$ and every configuration $d$ of $N$ whose state is $\\mathrm{emb}(e)$, if the configuration obtained from $d$ by replacing its state with $e$ satisfies $C$’s precondition, the run of $N$ from $d$ agrees, at every time up to and including that assigned time, with the run of $M$ from the state-replaced configuration after mapping its state by $\\mathrm{emb}$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a contract for $M$ with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$
$N$ has the same number of work tapes and input alphabet as $M$
Transitions of $N$ at embedded good states equal the state-mapped transitions of $M$
Every state visited strictly before contract time from an admissible entry start is good
$d$ is a configuration of $N$ with state $\\mathrm{emb}(e)$
The state-replaced configuration satisfies the contract precondition for $i$
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract for a machine $M$ with entry state $\mathrm{entry}$ and exit set
$X$, and let $N$ be another machine whose states include an injective image of the
states of $M$, given by $\mathrm{emb}$. Suppose that whenever $q$ satisfies
$\mathrm{good}$, the transition of $N$ at $\mathrm{emb}(q)$ is the state-relabeling by
$\mathrm{emb}$ of the transition of $M$ at $q$. Suppose also that every state visited by
$M$ strictly before the contract time, from any admissible start configuration in entry
state, satisfies $\mathrm{good}$. For any configuration $d$ of $N$ with state
$\mathrm{emb}(\mathrm{entry})$, and any index $i$ for which the constant-state
relabeling of $d$ to state $\mathrm{entry}$ satisfies $C$’s precondition, the run of $N$
from $d$ agrees through every time $u$ at most that contract’s time with the
state-embedded run of $M$ from the relabeled configuration.
